comments.1: Listen for what Melos promises before he leaves.
comments.2: Melos promised to return, and his friend chose to trust him. What will happen as Melos makes his way back to the city?
comments.3: Melos is badly hurt, and for a moment he thinks about giving up. What will make him keep going, and will he reach the city in time?

preview.text: This story follows a young shepherd who speaks out against a ruler and is sentenced to die. As he faces a choice that affects someone close to him, what will guide him through this moment of great pressure?
